what: Restoring a backup taken before a reset is wiped by the next Drive sync. The backup carries its old epoch (0); Drive holds the post-reset epoch (1), so pullOrPush sees er>ea and adopts the empty Drive copy ('Progress was reset on another device; applied'). Restoring after an accidental reset, the main reason to restore, silently undoes itself within 8 s.
evidence: t25/sabotage.py S3b: seed xp 100, copy backup, connect, Reset x2, sync, Restore the backup -> S=[epoch 0, xp 100]; syncAll(true) -> [epoch 1, xp 0, 'Progress was reset on another device; applied'].
fix: In bkApply set the restored state's epoch to Math.max(+S.epoch||0,+st.epoch||0) (the current epoch, never lower) before S=migrate(st), then call syncAll(true) so it merges with Drive. Optionally offer 'Replace on all devices' which uses current epoch+1.

what: Reset says 'Erases lessons, stats, XP and mistakes on this device. Settings stay.' but with Drive connected it bumps epoch and wipes every synced phone and the Drive copy, and it also erases the real gas log (gaslog is not in keep{} and is not mentioned).
evidence: S3: phone B Reset; phone A syncs -> A shows epoch 1, xp 0, done [], logList().length 0 (A had 4 logged gases). Row text read from the page: 'Erases lessons, stats, XP and mistakes on this device. Settings stay.'
fix: Change the copy when signedIn(): 'Erases progress on this device, on your Drive and on your other devices, including the gas log.' Add a choice: 'Reset this device only' (keep epoch, just clear locally and re-pull? or simply sign out first) vs 'Reset everywhere'. Keep S.gaslog in keep{} unless the user ticks 'also delete my gas log'.

what: Work done on another phone after the reset (but synced later) is thrown away: the higher epoch wins outright, so anything newer than the reset is lost, including newly logged real gases.
evidence: S3: A offline adds done 'l-after', xp+7 and logs a gas; B resets and syncs; A comes online -> A adopts [epoch 1, xp 0, done [], log 0]. Only localStorage 'buffer_before_drive' keeps it, with no UI.
fix: Store resetAt (ISO) with the epoch. When adopting a higher epoch, re-merge local items whose timestamps are after resetAt (gaslog/cmist by u, days >= reset date, sess with d >= reset date, qmiss values > resetAt). At minimum show a toast 'Progress was reset on another device. Undo on this phone' that restores buffer_before_drive.

what: Two phones connecting at the same moment create two 'My Apps/hub/buffer' folders; each phone caches its own folder id in buffer_drive_ids and keeps using it, so the phones never merge again and Citrus sees two status.json files. Same risk when Citrus and Buffer create 'My Apps' or 'hub' at once.
evidence: t25/race.py: both phones tap Connect together -> state.json in two different buffer folders (f5, f7); A ids f3/buffer=f7, B f3/buffer=f5; after 2 more sync rounds A done ['l-a'], B done ['l-b'] (never merged).
fix: In folder(), always list by name+parent (orderBy createdTime) and use the oldest; if more than one exists, merge the newer folder's state.json into the oldest and trash the extra folder. Re-validate the cached id against the oldest at least once per session instead of trusting it.

where: mergeStates xp/read and pickRec (kinds, speed, cases)
what: Counters merge by max / larger-n-wins, so offline work on one phone is lost whenever both phones studied: xp 100 -> A +50, B +30 merges to 150 not 180; speed pflash A n 20 best 100, B n 15 lvl 4 merges to n 20 lvl 2 (B's 5 drills and level lost); case ch-dka keeps B's record and drops A's best=1.
evidence: S1 in t25/sabotage.py: results xp 150; speed {'n':20,'c':18,'best':100,'lvl':2}; cases {'res':'2 wrong turns','n':3} without best.
fix: Make counters per-device: store S.ctr[deviceId]={xp,read,roundsDone} and sum across devices (a G-counter); for records merge field-wise: n,c as per-device sums or at least max per field, best=max, lvl=max, last=max, res from the record with the larger last.

what: A state.json that parses but has the wrong type for a field (e.g. gaslog as an object, days as a string) throws '(b || []) is not iterable' on every sync. Sync and status.json publishing stop permanently, with only the raw TypeError shown.
evidence: S4: set Drive state.json gaslog={'oops':1}, days='2026-11-12' -> G.line '(b || []) is not iterable'; every later sync fails and writeStatus is skipped (ok=false).
fix: Sanitise the remote copy before merging: in mergeLog/unionArr use Array.isArray(x)?x:[]; for maps use x&&typeof x==='object'&&!Array.isArray(x)?x:{}. Run migrate() on both sides inside the ui6 wrapper (it uses raw A/B). If merge still throws, fall back to treating the remote as unreadable (push local) and keep a copy as state.damaged-<date>.json.

where: Token expiry by time (signedIn, click renewal)
what: If Buffer stays open past the token lifetime (about 1 h), signedIn() turns false but G.expired stays false, so: the save hook stops syncing silently, the any-tap renewal never fires, and the Citrus line says 'Google sign-in expired · tap to reconnect' although tapping does nothing (only the Reconnect button works).
evidence: S6b: G.exp=Date.now()-1000; save(); tap a tab -> [signedIn false, __tok unchanged, G.expired false]; Citrus line reads 'Google sign-in expired · tap to reconnect. Progress saved to Drive'. Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T25-citrus-line-expired.png
fix: Derive expiry from time: in the click handler and in save() use const dead=wasConnected()&&!signedIn(); set G.expired=true when G.tok&&G.exp<=Date.now(). Also clear G.line when the state changes so the old 'Progress saved to Drive' does not sit next to 'expired'.

what: With FiO2 typed as a percentage (40), the hand-off calls interp() on the raw IV (fio2 40), gets an error object and sends a file with no title, no read and empty steps, but still toasts 'Sent to My Apps/hub/handoff'. The on-screen read works because ui3/ui6 divide FiO2 >1 by 100.
evidence: dl.py: loadInterp({...po2:60,fio2:40...}); runInterp(); tap Hand off -> file content {'gas':{'fio2':40,...},'steps':[],'next':[]} with no 'title'/'read'. With fio2 0.4 the file is complete.
fix: Before interp in the hand-off: if(inp.fio2!=null&&inp.fio2>1)inp.fio2/=100; if(o.err){toast('Fix the input first');return;}. Better: reuse the exact inp/o built in the ui6 runInterp wrapper (store it in a module variable LASTREAD).

what: Gas keys are case-sensitive and partial or invalid input falls back to the built-in demo gas. ?from=galen&do=interp&pH=7.21&pCO2=60 (or ph=abc) opens the interpreter showing the default example (pH 7.21, PCO2 24, Na 136 ... 'HAGMA + respiratory acidosis'), which looks like Galen's patient but is not.
evidence: dl.py GALEN ?from=galen&do=interp&pH=7.21&pCO2=60 -> IV {pH:7.21,pco2:24,po2:108,na:136,...} read 'HAGMA + respiratory acidosis'.
fix: Read params case-insensitively (lower-case the keys first; accept pco2/pCO2/PaCO2, hco3/HCO3). If any gas key arrived but pH or PCO2 is missing or not a number, open a cleared form with the values that did arrive and toast 'Galen sent pH only; add PCO2'. Never show the demo gas on a from=galen link.

what: The weekly-review proposal uses the ISO week of today and is offered on Sat, Sun and Mon. On Monday the id changes to the new week (a second proposal after Saturday's) and the link opens Progress, whose weekly card now shows the new, almost empty week. ui6 adds 'Weekly review ready' on Sun/Mon only and Today's plan (ui10) on Sun/Mon: three different rules.
evidence: Code: ui9.js line 23 dow 0,1,6 with isoWeek(new Date()); ui6.js weeklyReview() uses weekStart() of today; ui6 pending uses getDay()===0||1; ui10 line 52 dow 0||1. isoWeek itself is correct (checked 2024-2030 against Python isocalendar, 0 mismatches).
fix: Define one helper reviewWeek(): on Mon use the previous week, otherwise the current one. Use its ISO week for the inbox id, pass &wk=<id> in the URL, and make the weekly card show that week. Use the same days (Sat-Mon or Sun-Mon) in ui6, ui9 and ui10, and add expires (end of Monday) to the inbox item.

what: The 'send N missed points to Yuzu' proposal never goes away: qmiss is never cleared or marked as sent, so once 5 misses exist Citrus shows the task every week forever, and each weekly pack resends all old misses.
evidence: S8: after sending the pack to Yuzu, hubStatus().inbox still contains {'id':'buffer-yuzu-2026w46','title':'Buffer: send 7 missed points to Yuzu'}. grep shows S.qmiss is only ever set (ui1.js:189), never deleted.
fix: Store S.yzSent={key:timestamp} (or a sentAt per miss) when a pack is written; count only unsent misses for the inbox item and the pack; remove a qmiss key when the question is later answered correctly. Merge yzSent with maxN.

what: status.json has no progress[] field, which Citrus contract v2 expects.
evidence: S5: required-field check -> missing ['progress'] (status.json at My Apps/hub/buffer/status.json).
fix: Add s.progress, e.g. [{key:'mastery',label:'Mastery',value:masteryScore(),max:100,unit:'%'},{key:'lessons',label:'Lessons done',value:Object.keys(S.done).length,max:L.length},{key:'cases',label:'Cases done',value:Object.keys(S.cases||{}).length,max:CASES.length}] following hub-contract.md's shape.

what: Contract fields missing on some items: metric 'live-gases' has no goal; action 'log' has no minutes.
evidence: S5: [{'key':'live-gases',...no goal}] and [{'id':'log',...no minutes}].
fix: Give live-gases goal:null (or a weekly target such as 5) explicitly, and the log action minutes:2. Rename the metric label to 'Real gases logged this week' since the value is w.live for this week.

what: asks[] emits slots 'early' and 'postnight' as well as 'free'/'before'; the Citrus contract lists slot free/before. (Doubt: Citrus may accept more values; check hub-contract.md.)
evidence: Baseline twophones.py: tomorrow after a night shift -> ask {slot:'postnight',minutes:10}; slotFor() returns 'early' when a shift starts before 07:00.
fix: Either map early/postnight to 'free' with a separate field (kind:'postnight') or update hub-contract.md and Citrus to accept them.

what: Inbox items carry no expires, so a weekly review or Yuzu proposal can sit in Citrus after the week is over.
evidence: S8 inbox item: {'id':'buffer-yuzu-2026w46','type':'task',...} with no expires.
fix: Add expires: ISO end of the review day (Mon 23:59 local) for the weekly item and end of the ISO week for the Yuzu item.

what: When Drive is connected but the Yuzu folders are missing, the message 'Could not reach Yuzu on Drive (Yuzu folder not found)' is overwritten at once by the copy message, which then tells a connected user to 'connect Google to send it straight to Yuzu'.
evidence: S8: no My Apps/Yuzu -> #wkYuzuMsg 'Clipboard blocked. 3 cards. Save as buffer-misses.yuzu.json and import in Yuzu, or connect Google to send it straight to Yuzu.' Same with Yuzu present but no collection.
fix: Keep the reason: 'Yuzu's Drive folder was not found (open Yuzu once and connect Google there). Copied N cards instead.' Drop the 'connect Google' tail when signedIn(). Same for the glossary #glMsg.

what: On Drive failure the toast 'Drive failed; copied instead' is immediately replaced by the copy toast, so the user never learns the hand-off did not reach Drive.
evidence: Code: catch -> toast('Drive failed; copied instead') then falls through to copyText and a second toast.
fix: Return after building one combined toast: 'Drive failed (reason). Hand-off copied; paste it into the reasoning app.'

what: ?do=case&id=<bad>, ?do=lesson&id=<bad> and unknown do= values land silently on Today with the back chip and no message.
evidence: dl.py: ?from=citrus&do=case&id=nope -> VIEW 'today', no toast; same for lesson nope and do=bogus.
fix: Toast 'That case is not in this version of Buffer' and open the case library / Learn instead.

what: There is no units parameter; a kPa gas from Galen (pco2=8&po2=7.5) is read as mmHg (PCO2 8 mmHg accepted, HCO3 3.1) until PO2 trips the range check.
evidence: dl.py GALEN ?ph=7.21&pco2=8&po2=7.5 -> IV {pco2:8,po2:7.5,hco3:3.1} 'PO2 7.5 is outside the possible range'.
fix: Accept &units=kPa (multiply pco2/po2 by 7.50062) and document the link format for Galen; when no units are given and pco2<15, assume kPa and say so.

what: The back chip vanishes on reload (FROM is lost after replaceState), cannot be dismissed, and on a phone it sits over content (Today's plan rows, the interpreter's PO2 field).
evidence: Screenshots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T25-chip-today-phone.png and /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T25-galen-chip-phone.png; dl.py 'chip after reload' False.
fix: Keep FROM in sessionStorage; add bottom padding to .view when the chip shows (or put the chip in the header bar); add a small x to dismiss it.

what: Drive errors are shown as raw JSON ('Drive 429: {"error": {"code": 429, "message": ...') in Settings and the Citrus line, while the status box stays green 'Connected'. The Retry-After header is ignored (back-off 0.8/1.6/3.2 s, so a 30-60 s quota window still fails; the sync took 17 s and failed).
evidence: S7 persistent 429; screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T25-google-card-429.png. Also the error text is carried into the later 'Sign-in expired' line (/tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T25-google-adv-deck.png).
fix: Parse the error JSON: map 429/403 rateLimit to 'Google Drive is busy; will retry in a minute', 403 storageQuotaExceeded to 'Your Drive is full', 404 to 'File missing'. Honour Retry-After (cap 60 s) and schedule one later retry. Show an amber state in .g-status when the last sync failed, and clear G.line on sign-in changes.

what: There is no 'online' listener: after offline edits nothing syncs until the next save or a 10-minute visibility return; the box still says 'Connected' with 'No connection'.
evidence: S1: sync while offline -> G.line 'No connection' after ~5 s of retries; no automatic retry on reconnect.
fix: addEventListener('online',()=>signedIn()&&syncAll(false)); show 'Offline · will sync when back' in the status box.

what: Each sync makes 13 Drive calls when nothing changed and 19 when forced, and every app backgrounding forces a full upload plus a verify read even when the hash matches. This raises the rate-limit risk and the chance of a sync being cut off at pagehide.
evidence: S2: CALLS per sync (no change, forced) = (13, 19); state.json 2 KB. Code: if(mh!==rh||opts.force) always PUTs.
fix: Skip the upload when mh===rh even when forced (force should mean 'check now', not 'rewrite'). Verify cached folder ids once per session, not on every call. Use fetch keepalive for the pagehide sync.

what: mergeLog sorts by x.t, which notebook entries do not have, so after a merge the order is 'phone A's entries then phone B's' rather than by time. The notebook shows reverse order, and the 200 cap in ui8 splices from the front, so it can drop new mistakes. Entries cut by the cap on one phone come back from the other on every merge, and the merged list has no cap.
evidence: S1: merged cmist order ['m1','m2','m3'] = array concatenation order. Code: ui6.js:97 sort uses t; ui8.js:58 splice(0,len-200).
fix: Sort by (x.t||'')||x.u: use (+x.u||Date.parse(x.t)||0). Cap after merge too (keep tombstones of the last 90 days and the 200 newest live entries).

what: Duplicate state.json files are trashed before their contents are read or merged, so the older copy's data only survives if the phone that wrote it syncs again.
evidence: Code: getJSON() calls trashExtras(files) before reading; S4 shows the good older copy is used only when the newest is damaged.
fix: Read every duplicate, mergeStates them into one, write it, then trash the extras.

what: If the Google script has not loaded yet (slow network, first 800 ms), connectGoogle awaits the script load and then calls requestAccessToken outside the tap, which phone browsers block as a pop-up. (Doubt: depends on browser activation rules; not reproducible headless.)
evidence: Code: hub.js:15 await gsi() before initTokenClient; preload at 800 ms only.
fix: Disable the Connect/Reconnect buttons until window.google.accounts exists ('Loading Google…'), and call requestAccessToken synchronously in the click handler.

what: adopt() keeps the pre-merge state in localStorage buffer_before_drive, but no screen offers to restore it.
evidence: S3: localStorage.getItem('buffer_before_drive') present after the reset was adopted; Settings has no option to use it.
fix: Add 'Undo the last Drive merge (dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm)' under Settings > Your data while that key exists.

what: Merge messages name navigator.platform: 'Merged with Linux x86_64' (on Android it says 'Linux armv8l', on an iPhone 'iPhone').
evidence: S4: G.line 'Merged with Linux x86_64'.
fix: Let the user name the device once (Settings, default 'Phone'/'Tablet'/'Steam Deck' from the user agent) and save it as S.google.deviceName; show 'Merged with Tablet at 14:02'.

what: When connected, the primary orange button is 'Reconnect' and 'Sync now' is secondary; there is no 'last synced' time.
evidence: Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T25-google-card-429.png.
fix: Connected: primary 'Sync now', secondary 'Sign out', link 'Reconnect' under Advanced; add 'Last synced 13/11/2026 14:02' from a saved timestamp.

what: Gas-log tombstones are stripped (good), but notebook removals keep q/a/r, so removed items stay in Drive state forever.
evidence: S1: m1 tombstone still holds q,a,r,ct.
fix: Make notebook removal match logDel: keep only id,key,u,del.

what: buffer.html has no <!doctype> or <meta charset='utf-8'>; served by a plain static server (python http.server) every ·, ₂, → and emoji turns into mojibake (the PWA index.html does have the charset). (Doubt: the claude.ai artifact wrapper may add it.)
evidence: Screenshots /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T25-chip-today-phone.png show 'Â·' and 'â†' in the header and chip.
fix: Start shell.html with <!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"> (first 1024 bytes).

what: In the clinical skin the back chip keeps the pixel look (square corners, 2px ink border) while the rest of the clinical UI is rounded.
evidence: Screenshot /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/shots/T25-chip-deck-clinical-light.png.
fix: Add [data-skin=clinical] .fromchip{border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.

what: Use per-device counters and field-wise record merges (see the counter finding); this removes most 'max wins' losses and makes the merge provably additive.
evidence: S1 results.
fix: Add S.dev (random id); S.ctr[dev]; derived totals.

what: Publish sync health in status.json (lastSyncOk, lastSyncAt, error) so Citrus can say 'Buffer has not synced for 3 days'.
evidence: Today a broken sync leaves status.json stale without any hint.
fix: Add s.sync={ok,at,error} in hubStatus.

what: Add a 'Citrus contract preview' that shows the status.json about to be written and validates the required fields (like S5 in t25/sabotage.py).
evidence: Would have caught the missing progress[] and the metric/action gaps.
fix: Render JSON.stringify(hubStatus(),null,1) with ticks per field.

what: Commit the fake-Drive sabotage harness (t25/sabotage.py, race.py, dl.py) to /home/claude/buffer/tests so every release reruns two-phone, reset, restore, corruption, 429 and expiry scenarios.
evidence: Harness at /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/80312b5f-0e45-5589-b131-fcf824f33899/scratchpad/beta/t25/.
fix: Copy into tests/ and point it at buffer.html.

what: Let the user edit a log entry's note and tag (merge already resolves edits by u), and offer 'delete all gases with this tag' at the end of a shift.
evidence: Today the only change is delete.
fix: Add an Edit button that updates note/tag and sets u=Date.now().

what: Give each hand-off a stable id and let the reasoning app write back handoff/<id>.done.json; show 'Picked up by the reasoning app' in Buffer and trash hand-offs older than 30 days.
evidence: Hand-offs accumulate in My Apps/hub/handoff with no feedback.
fix: Add id and a small reader in syncAll.

what: Consider the drive.file scope: all family apps share one client ID, so files they create stay visible to each other, and the consent screen is far less alarming than full Drive access. (Doubt: files or folders the user made by hand would be invisible.)
evidence: scope 'openid email https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive'.
fix: Test drive.file across Citrus, Yuzu and Buffer before switching.

what: Renewing on any tap opens Google's window in the middle of a quiz answer or a case step. Prefer a slim top banner 'Drive paused · Reconnect' with one button.
evidence: document click handler hub.js:142.
fix: Replace the global handler with a banner button.
